verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm published GitBook docs pages serve a markdown mirror at URL+.md (e.g. quickstart.md returning '# Quickstart') plus a live llms.txt index, directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-GitBook-authored) confirmation across customer-hosted sites rather than just GitBook's own docs, and no evidence of .md working universally across all page types/edge cases.
